Section Name:BUDGET
Title:HEAD V - MINISTRY OF TRADE AND INDUSTRY
MPs Speaking:Assoc. Prof. Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim (Marine Parade);Dr Lam Pin Min (Ang Mo Kio);Mdm Ho Geok Choo (West Coast);Miss Penny Low (Pasir Ris-Punggol);Mr Abdullah Tarmugi;Mr Chan Soo Sen (Joo Chiat);Mr Chiam See Tong (Potong Pasir);Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Holland-Bukit Timah);Mr Michael Palmer (Pasir Ris-Punggol);Mr Teo Siong Seng (Nominated Member);Mr Yeo Guat Kwang (Aljunied);Mr Zaqy Mohamad (Hong Kah);Ms Indranee Rajah (Tanjong Pagar);Ms Jessica Tan Soon Neo (East Coast);The Chairman;The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Lim Hng Kiang);The Minister of State for Trade and Industry and Manpower (Mr Lee Yi Shyan);The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr S Iswaran);The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong)

Column: 3622

 

 

     Ms Jessica Tan Soon Neo: Mr Chairman, I would like a clarification with regard to the commercialisation of R&D. Could the Senior Minister of State share more about the IP framework in terms of how we will support and encourage development of IP in Singapore?  He talked about commercialisation of IP, but could he share a little more about the IP framework to encourage companies to develop and base their IP in Singapore?
expected_rows: Mr Chairman, I would like a clarification with regard to the commercialisation of R&D. Could the Senior Minister of State share more about the IP framework in terms of how we will support and encourage development of IP in Singapore? He talked about commercialisation of IP, but could he share a little more about the IP framework to encourage companies to develop and base their IP in Singapore?
